from __future__ import annotations

import pygame


def main() -> None:
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((1280, 720))
    pygame.display.set_caption('Jarvis Game Engine Prototype')
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    x, y = 640, 360
    vx, vy = 0, 0
    accel = 0.7
    damping = 0.86
    running = True

    while running:
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        if keys[pygame.K_a]:
            vx -= accel
        if keys[pygame.K_d]:
            vx += accel
        if keys[pygame.K_w]:
            vy -= accel
        if keys[pygame.K_s]:
            vy += accel

        vx *= damping
        vy *= damping
        x += vx
        y += vy

        screen.fill((12, 14, 20))
        pygame.draw.circle(screen, (64, 220, 255), (int(x), int(y)), 28)
        pygame.display.flip()
        clock.tick(60)

    pygame.quit()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
